upright.general: The Devil represents bondage to unhealthy desires, addictions, fear, or material attachments. It highlights situations where a person feels trapped by their own choices, emotions, or habits. The card encourages awareness and liberation from self-imposed limitations.
upright.in_love: Relationships may involve obsession, jealousy, manipulation, or unhealthy emotional dependence. Strong physical attraction can overshadow emotional harmony. Singles may be drawn into toxic or superficial connections.
upright.in_situation: A situation is influenced by fear, greed, control, or unhealthy ambition. Hidden motives or destructive patterns may prevent growth and clarity.
upright.meaning_for_today: Today may reveal unhealthy attachments, temptations, or limiting beliefs. Awareness and self-control will help you regain balance and freedom.
upright.card_advice: Face your fears and recognize what controls you. Break free from toxic habits, dependencies, and illusions to reclaim your personal power.

reversed.general: Reversed The Devil signifies breaking free from toxic influences, addictions, or limiting beliefs. Awareness grows, allowing healing and personal empowerment. Recovery and liberation become possible.
reversed.in_love: A relationship may recover from unhealthy dynamics, or a person may finally leave a toxic connection. Emotional independence and honesty help restore balance.
reversed.in_situation: The situation improves as fear and control lose their influence. Old habits are abandoned, creating opportunities for healthier choices and personal growth.
reversed.meaning_for_today: Today marks a powerful breakthrough and a return of your personal autonomy. If you have been wrestling with a toxic habit, a codependent relationship, or a deeply ingrained mindset of self-sabotage, the fog is finally clearing. You are seeing the chains for what they really are—completely unlocked all along. Today brings the strength to say 'enough' and walk away from whatever has been draining your spirit and controlling your life.
reversed.card_advice: The chains are loose, so start running and don't look back. The reversed Devil card urges you to capitalize on this moment of clarity and permanently cut ties with whatever has held you back. Stop making excuses for old dependencies or toxic cycles. Reclaim your sovereignty, acknowledge the role you played in staying trapped, and proudly step into your newfound freedom. You are the master of your own destiny now.
